question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party, Central Military Commission, and state institutions through extensive personnel appointments and recent military purges that have reinforced rather than undermined his authority. Public reporting through mid-2026 shows no factional challenges, health disclosures, or policy ruptures capable of forcing an early exit ahead of the scheduled 2027 National Congress, where leadership continuity patterns historically prevail. Trader consensus at 95.5% for continued tenure reflects these structural barriers and the absence of visible elite opposition. Low-probability shifts could still stem from a sudden medical event, severe economic downturn prompting internal realignment, or an unforeseen external crisis before the December 2026 resolution window.
